source: US QWERTY as the physical key names in docs/SPEC-SCHEMA.md (Key ids); each key id is named by its unshifted character and each modifier emits that character directly. This is not copied from any implementation -- the mapping IS the US keyboard, and the key-id convention is this project's own (SPEC-SCHEMA.md 'Key ids').

x-notes.why: SPEC-MODES R2 requires an English mode that selects qwerty/dvorak, and R6's OFF+English behaviour requires 'English mode has to be a Latin layout rather than a Hangul layout -- since a Latin key produces a Latin letter there is nothing to compose'. No such layout existed in libhunmin/data/layouts/, so R2's English arm was unmeasurable. This adds it.
x-notes.composition: There is none, by design. A literal value is not a jamo, so process_jamo() takes the ic.c:170 branch and commits it directly, leaving the buffer empty. That is what makes R6's 'commit per character' fall out rather than be special-cased.
x-notes.not_a_layout_choice: This is a data addition required to measure R8, not a decision to ship qwerty as the English mode. The maintainer decides which Latin layouts English mode offers.
